summary: Quality review of CC-0116 (scope Keystone DB credentials per ControlPlane). The new reconcile_dbcredentials.go faithfully mirrors the established per-CR patterns: dbCredentialRemoteKeyFor copies adminAppCredentialRemoteKeyFor's ns+name OpenBao path scoping, and reconcileDBCredentials uses the exact CreateOrUpdate+SetControllerReference idiom from ensureAppCredentialSecret. Condition type/reasons, the requeue const (dbCredentialsRequeueAfter, matching korcRequeueAfter cadence with a documented rationale), the //nolint:gosec G101 discipline, and the dual condition-map registrations (subConditionTypes + subReconcilerConditionTypes) all follow existing conventions. The change is genuinely surgical: the keystone operator is byte-identical (empty diff main...HEAD -- operators/keystone/), reconcile_keystone.go adds only a managed-mode SecretRef substitution guarded by ClusterRef != nil (commonv1 already imported), and the only SetupWithManager change is the new Owns(&esov1.ExternalSecret{}) watch (mirrored in the envtest harness). Docs are thorough and accurate: the sub-reconciler count is updated 5->6 in every location, the DBCredentialsReady condition/reason table, projected-children table, metric-label table, OpenBao path-migration table, and vitepress sidebar all match the code; no live consumer references the legacy flat openstack/keystone/db path (remaining references are all migration notes, comments, cleanup docs, or the test's negative-assertion constant). The dbCredentialSecretName name-only choice (keystoneName(cp)+"-db-credentials") is documented as an explicit DECISION, is pattern-consistent with adminAppCredentialSecretName (also name-only), and is acceptable because the Secret is namespace-scoped while the OpenBao remote key (the actual shared-backend blast radius) embeds both namespace and name. Stage-b (dynamic DB engine / PushSecret) is correctly framed as deferred/not-implemented in the explanation doc. Test names accurately describe their coverage and the assertions back them up. Only two LOW documentation/comment nits found; nothing blocking.

issues_found.description: The explanation doc cross-references numbered sections "§4" and "§5" (in the Migration bullets) but its headings are not numbered (e.g. '## Deferred: operator-owned PushSecret + `push-keystone-db.hcl`' and '## Stage-b: dynamic database secret engine'). A reader cannot resolve §4/§5 to a heading. Cosmetic only.
issues_found.fix: Either number the headings (## 4. Deferred..., ## 5. Stage-b...) or replace the "§4"/"§5" references with the heading titles (e.g. "the Deferred PushSecret section" / "the Stage-b section").

issues_found.description: The driveCredentialChain comment states the chain runs 'KORC -> AdminCredential -> Catalog -> DBCredentials -> Keystone', which diverges from the production order where DBCredentials runs BEFORE KORC (Infrastructure -> DBCredentials -> Keystone -> KORC -> AdminCredential -> Catalog). The comment correctly scopes its claim to the 'immediately BEFORE reconcileKeystone' sub-invariant so it is not technically wrong, but the stated chain order could mislead a reader into thinking production runs DBCredentials after Catalog. Worth a clarifying phrase that this is a test-only ordering preserving only the DBCredentials-immediately-before-Keystone invariant.
issues_found.fix: Append to the comment that this is a test-only chain order which intentionally differs from production (where DBCredentials precedes KORC) and only preserves the DBCredentials-immediately-before-Keystone gate the assertions rely on.

suggested_improvements: Consider extracting a shared per-CR ExternalSecret-builder helper if a third per-CP read-only ExternalSecret is ever added; today two instances (admin clouds.yaml read ES via PushSecret family + this DB-credential ES) do not yet justify the abstraction (YAGNI-correct as-is).
Optionally add a CI grep-gate asserting no live manifest references the flat `openstack/keystone/db\b` path, to prevent regressions; the facts confirm none exists today but nothing enforces it.
next_steps: Optionally apply the two LOW doc/comment clarifications (both AUTO_FIX, non-blocking).
